about: S2-15 overlap audit (P09b, 2026-11-12): realistic asks, each with the ONE tool that serves it, written and committed before any ranking was run on them. Groups are the candidate overlaps; an ask is unambiguous when its tool outranks every other tool of its group in find_tool's own order. Frozen: do not edit the asks or their tools after this commit; a later audit writes a new file.
